plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch covariate
plan.analytical_narrative: Twelve kidney bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated vs 6 control, salmon gene counts, 12000 genes) were processed in two known batches, each holding both conditions — a balanced design, so batch is added as a fixed covariate in the model rather than corrected out of the counts beforehand. The workflow follows the grounded DESeq2 procedure: sample-structure QC (blinded VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) confirms whether batch or condition dominates variance before any test runs; a minimal low-count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size) removes untestable genes without pre-empting independent filtering; DESeq2's median-of-ratios normalization stays internal to the negative-binomial model; the design ~batch + condition with an explicit reference level (control) is fit with the Wald test, and apeglm shrinks the condition log2 fold change for reporting and ranking. edgeR quasi-likelihood on the same design is run as a second method, and the overlap of the two gene lists is reported as the high-confidence set, since two-method agreement is standard practice at n=6/group. Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering selects the differentially expressed genes, with the p-value histogram inspected as a fit diagnostic. The DESeq2 Wald statistic ranks the full gene list for preranked fgsea enrichment (a disputed metric choice, stated explicitly) against MSigDB Hallmark (50 sets, human, staged locally) and Reactome (staged locally) as a second collection, both filtered to the 15-500 gene window and collapsed for redundancy. A final report assembles fit diagnostics, the DE gene table (shrunken and unshrunken log2FC), the two-method overlap, the enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record (session info, seed, package and collection versions).

steps.method: vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library sizes
keep genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
design = ~batch + condition, explicit reference level, batch as fixed covariate
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Integrated DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, reproducibility record
